sources.locator: Faure et al. (2024), Eqs. (9), (12), (23)-(25); Table 1; Methods: Lasso regression models.
whmatrixextms-benchmarking.ipynb: H_matrix_recursive, H_matrix, V_matrix; whmatrixextms.py fit_lasso (fit_intercept=False).

scope: Fixed-alpha author objective replay on a complete centered synthetic landscape, where penalized versus unpenalized constant agrees. Does not reproduce Figure 2 or author CV/data splitting.
preprocessing: Uniform observed Cartesian product; fitness as supplied, maximize=True, epsilon=0; no imputation, transformations, duplicates, sample weighting or measurement-error propagation; graph nodes verified unchanged. Reference is first observation. No RNG in OLS. Full max_order=3; L1 alpha=0.05, no feature scaling, fit_intercept=False with constant included as in author code. Centered full-space fitness ensures constant is zero. tol=1e-12, max_iter=100000 for numeric convergence.

comparison.justification: Independent author-matrix solver replay; tolerance covers coordinate-descent ordering differences, with KKT conditions checked separately.
